board: Alabama State Board of Public Accountancy

cycle.note: Alabama CPE years run October 1 – September 30: 40 hours, including 2 ethics and 8 accounting & auditing. You register every year.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: 40 hours each CPE year (Ala. Admin. Code 30-X-5).

requirements.label: Accounting & auditing
requirements.note: At least 8 of the 40 in accounting and auditing — required of every active CPA.

requirements.label: Personal development
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 12 personal development hours count.

requirements.label: Nano-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Nano-learning is limited to 25% (10 hours).

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 2 hours in a qualifying ethics course every year.

newLicensee.note: New CPAs start earning CPE on the October 1 after their first active registration.

licenseDateHint: Alabama registrations are renewed every year (due by October 1, with a grace period). CPE years run October–September regardless.
issueDateHint: If you were licensed this CPE year (since October 1), CPE starts next October 1.
limitsNotTracked: Teaching: twice the lecture hours, no credit for repeats.
Software courses count as A&A only if about accounting or audit applications.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for 5 years after completion.
toVerify: A rule amendment filed May 2026 (effective date pending).
